# Customer research: Tidewater Plumbing

## Who buys

| Segment | Trigger moment (why now) | What they tried before | How they find solutions | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Homeowners 35 to 65 | Water on the floor, no hot water, blocked drain | A hardware store fix, a handyman | Google search on a phone, map listings | https://www.example.com/reviews/tidewater-plumbing |
| Landlords with 2 to 10 units | A tenant reports a leak | Their usual plumber who cannot come today | Google search, referrals | provided by owner, 2026-09-28 |

Primary segment for the first page: homeowners with an urgent leak, searching on a phone.

## Jobs to be done

1. When water is leaking in my house, I want someone reliable here today, so I can stop the damage and get back to my day.
2. When I call a plumber, I want to know the price before they start, so I can say yes without dreading the bill.

## Pains

| Rank | Pain | How it shows up in their day | What it costs them | Times seen | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Not knowing the price until the end | Hesitates to call, delays the repair | Bigger water damage, stress | 14 | https://www.example.com/reviews/competitor-a |
| 2 | Waiting all day for a vague time slot | Takes a day off work | Lost wages | 11 | https://forum.example.org/t/plumber-no-show |
| 3 | Fix fails a week later | Pays twice | Money and trust | 6 | https://www.example.com/reviews/competitor-b |

## Objections and fears

| The price will balloon | "Quoted 150, paid 600" | Fixed price agreed before work starts | Review mentioning the fixed quote |
| They will not show up | "Waited from 8 to 5, nobody came" | Text with an arrival window within 15 minutes | Review mentioning punctuality |

## Language bank

Words they use for the problem: leak, water everywhere, burst pipe, no hot water, blocked drain

Words they use for the outcome: fixed the same day, no drama, price up front, showed up on time

Phrases worth reusing in headlines: "fixed the same day", "price before he touched anything", "showed up on time"

Our jargon they never use (avoid on the page): service call, diagnostic fee, remediation
